notes: Local test package for v1.9.2-cp7.2. This is not a published GitHub release. Channel is test, so Link will not treat it as stable. A board on v1.9.1-cp7.2 should show this as an upgrade. The write is app-only at 0x10000 and leaves NVS and the sound partition alone. Flash baud is at most 460800. A USB power loss during the write is not an atomic update; Link keeps a backup under Local AppData.
